title: DPAE
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Single-channel epoch
description: Input waveform, batch x 1 x samples.

nodes.title: Fine-scale pathway
description: Small kernels and dilated convolutions; pooled latent features.

nodes.title: Concatenate latents
description: Concatenate both pathway latents along the channel axis.

nodes.title: Pointwise fusion
description: 1x1 convolution, BatchNorm and activation fuse the pathways.

nodes.title: Waveform decoder
description: Upsampling convolutional decoder; restore the input length.

nodes.title: Artifact prediction
description: Add learned residual_scale x input to the decoded artifact.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Single-channel epoch
Artifact prediction to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
